vaidhībhakti
(‘devotion associated with vidhis or rules’)
------------------------------------------
Bhakti or devotion has been categorised in different ways. One of them is वैधीभक्ति and rāgānugābhakti.
The former is devotion associated with many preliminary rules and regulations like physical and ceremonial purity, ritualistic worship, chanting of hymns, observing certain rules about ड़ोओद्, ड़स्तिन्ग् and so on. See also RĀGĀNUGABHAKTI.
